newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica's JSE gold shares slide 3 pct on bullion.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica's JSE gold shares slide 3 pct on bullion.

text.p: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange's All-Gold index fell three percent at the opening of trade on Friday in the wake of the bullion price's fall to 12-year lows.
By 0742 GMT the gold index had continued its opening slide, falling 38 points or 3.86 percent to 947.2 points.
The gold price slumped to a 12-year low late Thursday on Australian central bank gold sales and remained vulnerable to further losses, dealers and analysts in London said.
It was last bid at $323.75 an ounce.
In New York on Thursday night spot gold was quoted at $325.00/50 an ounce after briefly seeing a low at $323.70.
The move took spot gold down to its lowest levels since early December 1985 when gold was recovering from the low of $281 an ounce seen in February 1985.
